Attached: 1 image

It only took 2 and half weeks of back and forth through a ticketing system, but I now have control of my old World of Warcraft mod, Runestone!

https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/runestone

I was shocked to learn that someone was hoping it would get updated 3 years ago! Well now it is. I released a new version 4 today, only 13 years after the last release in 2013.

#wow #warcraft #programming #lua #mmo
